claim: A Fast pick reached through the entrance loads about 8.8k est. tokens of instructions before ranking a single entry (entrance 1.3k + roadmap menu 0.9k + pick.md 6.0k + the shared destination-question file 0.6k) — down 65% from the roughly 25.5k the same flow loaded before prompt assembly moved into craft-handoff.js.

fixtures.role: the entrance every plain-language Foreman request hits first
the roadmap menu — Call 1 routing, shared by all five branches below
the standalone prompt builder, an advanced surface off the roadmap path
conditional add-on — read only when a flow takes its "skim it for field semantics" invitation
the shared destination question + fableEnabled resolve, read by the Fast pick (Q2) and craft-prompt (Call 5) flows

aggregate.statistic: single deterministic computation (no dispersion — repeating it returns the same values)

limitations: bytes/4 is an estimate, not a tokenizer count — the real token count for any of these files depends on the model's actual tokenizer and will differ from the number here.

These numbers are what each flow's own file instructs a session to read, not what a live session actually loads — a real conversation carries the roadmap's own JSON, tool results, and prior turns on top of every number here.

roadmap-schema.md is a conditional add-on and is excluded from every flow's core total. It appears only as optional_add_on, gated on a flow taking its own "skim it if you need field semantics" invitation. Cutting the duplicated CLI contract out of that file is most of why the add-on itself dropped from 14.7k to 2.3k est. tokens; the CLI now documents itself through --help.

Recomputed from R-012 after skills/craft-prompt/SKILL.md gained a starting-point question in Call 1 and a section on carrying a don't-know answer through the interview. Only that one file changed: craft_prompt moved 5,218 -> 5,908 est. tokens, and every other flow — including the fast pick this record's claim is about — is byte-identical to R-012.

The chain before this one: R-012 recomputed R-011 after the destination question and the fableEnabled resolve were deduplicated into one shared file both prompt-crafting flows read; R-011 recomputed R-010 for a one-line roadmap-schema.md cross-reference fix; R-010 recomputed R-008 after doctor.md gained its summary-reading sentences; R-008 recomputed R-007 at the 1.0 close; R-007 recomputed R-006, itself the successor to R-004.

Editing any fixture listed above invalidates this record — validate-records.js fails on the sha256 mismatch rather than letting a stale number keep supporting a README claim; a corrected measurement needs a new record with supersedes pointing here.

The ~25,497 est. token before-figure the claim compares against comes from an unpublished working measurement taken the same way, carried here as historical context only, not something this record's own command reproduces.

environment.foreman_commit names the PARENT commit. This record ships in the same commit as the fixture edits it measures, so that commit sha cannot appear inside it; the fixture sha256 values above, not the commit, are what pin the bytes.
